_about: Model preferences for the start-task skill, by tier. resolve-model.py picks, at run time, the first candidate that is in the harness's live catalog and answers a one-word ping. Patterns are shell globs, tried in order; several matches of one glob are tried newest version first. Claude Code is not listed: its subagents use the aliases `opus` and `sonnet` in .claude/agents/, which always resolve to the latest models. Add the models your own machine offers; if nothing matches, the subagent inherits the main session's model.

strong.used_by: the reviewer subagent; also what to start the main session on

codex._note: OpenAI first, as listed on developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing on 2026-09-27; the Grok entries serve a Codex pointed at an xAI-compatible provider. Catalogs do not overlap, so order between the two families does not matter. gpt-6-sol costs what Sonnet 5 costs, so it is the strong tier and the fast tier drops one size to Luna; gpt-6-astra ($10/$50) is left out on cost.
